text: ポケモンは　たたかわせる　ものさ　レッド…！

structure.jp: たたかわせる　ものさ

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending means making someone else do the action. たたかわせる = 'make them fight'.

patterns.name: 〜ものだ
patterns.span: たたかわせる　ものさ
patterns.explanation: ものだ after a verb says 'that's how things naturally are'. Here さ takes the place of だ. たたかわせる　ものさ = 'they're meant to be made to fight'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ at the end of a sentence states something in a breezy, sure-of-yourself way, in place of だ. ものさ = 'that's what they are'.
